mode_inference_decision.rationale: Only bounded local outer grid patches are faired against original source vertices. Existing original rig and motion are reused for diagnostics. No third-party character, rig or mocap is used.

method: One original-source-nearest guided outer-grid patch, fixed unselected perimeter, at most 6 mm movement; one correction changes the local inner treatment from discontinuous per-vertex miters to continuous co-movement.
failed_gates: Neutral and all measured poses retain 16 upper-arm and 22 forearm nonadjacent triangle self intersections.
Incident normal thickness falls below the 1.5 mm lower bound on upper armor, forearm armor and sleeve; some are nearly zero despite 2 mm paired-vertex distance.
Upper vertex 74 and forearm vertex 40 still fail local miter feasibility.
Upper and forearm nearest-source residuals worsen after fairing; neutral section gaps remain visible.
